title: Saturnia

body:
Saturnia is a legendary Thri-kreen archmage of the Zuk’Teuc, the ancestral people also associated with Scribonia. Her books outlasted her disappearance generations ago. To Scribonia she became a model of scholarship: a great sage whose image accompanied his own pursuit of arcane knowledge. Later testimony identifies her as a demigod and Keeper of the Arcane Secrets, although the circumstances of her ascension remain unknown.

The scholar beyond her maps

A Legend Lore vision recovered on 21 September 2026 shows a younger Saturnia arriving in Fenumion. Darkness and void give way to a flash and a gate different from the one modern adventurers know, but serving the same purpose. Saturnia carries books and many maps. None describe the land before her.

She appears young and inexperienced, confronted by a place her preparations cannot explain. A blond human paladin in shining armor approaches and introduces himself as Ser Kurayami. He welcomes her to the “fractured continent of Fenumion,” says the gods have sent a scholar, and warns that she will need knowledge of the arcane. This is a recovered glimpse of her arrival, not a complete account of her early travels. The ancient scene’s date and the duration of their acquaintance are not established.

Young Saturnia on arrival

The sage in the spellbook

Scribonia’s Manifest Mind takes Saturnia’s form. On 15 June 2024 a small spectral figure emerges from his spellbook, scouting and letting him see and cast through it. A later clarification describes the apparition as a roughly one-foot, ghostlike moth person. These scenes establish the spellbook manifestation; they do not establish that every appearance is the demigod personally intervening.

Her image also appears in a magical temptation on 27 June 2024. A vision of the great archmage offers Scribonia a seat and all the magical secrets he seeks while the Zuk’Teuc bow. The offer uses Saturnia’s appearance. It is not confirmed dialogue from the real Saturnia, and cannot be treated as proof of her intentions.

The manifestation is often joyful. On 11 July 2024 she dances through a library on phantom winds. On 4 November Scribonia summons a figure to scale to help him mirror a dance. By 19 August 2025 the manifestation stands at full height, shining like the North Star. Her starry dress reverses the colors of Scribonia’s clothing as their dance combines ballroom movement with Thri-kreen wings, antennae and abdominal flourishes. The scenes show how much warmth and companionship her image holds for him.

What knowledge costs

On 5 August 2024, when Moirah asks for a meaningful sacrifice, Scribonia summons a tiny Saturnia and holds the sad, sagelike figure in his hands. He apologizes to the Great Sage and says he wishes he could have met her. Closing and raising his spellbook, he offers his knowledge; blue energy accompanies Saturnia’s disappearance into the book.

The sacrifice expresses what scholarship means to him. It does not establish the death or destruction of Saturnia herself. Later manifestations remain part of the recovered record.

Keeper of the Arcane Secrets

On 30 May 2026 Eugene asks Vesperax who Saturnia is. Vesperax calls her the Keeper of the Arcane Secrets, an ancient vassal of the First God, bound to protect the realm’s arcana. This testimony gives her divine role a sharper meaning: the pursuit of knowledge has become a duty to guard it.

The record confirms demigodhood but leaves the transition unexplained. It does not identify the First God, date Saturnia’s ascension, or settle whether her binding was freely chosen. Her current location and the extent of direct intervention are likewise unresolved. The supplied portrait depicts Saturnia the goddess; it is kept distinct from the younger arrival recording.

Scribonia’s questions

By September 2026 Scribonia is investigating the relationship between the ancestral archmage and the divine figure. His account reports that Saturnia has taken an interest in his continued existence and used the words “my child.” That familial language prompts questions about a possible divine mother; it does not establish literal biological parenthood.

On 19 September he casts Legend Lore from an armchair in his pocket realm. The arrival scene follows on 21 September. Seeing Saturnia enter the unknown with her books and maps, he recognizes something of his own path in hers and considers seeking the Guardians for further answers. What happened between that arrival and her later office remains an open historical question.

Saturnia in the timeline

Dates identify recovered modern scenes. The ancient arrival is dated by its September 2026 revelation, not by an invented ancient calendar date.

What a later library search can establish

Scribonia’s October inquiry finds mentions connecting Saturnia with Mage’s Ruin, but the narrator explicitly says the ancient primary records are absent from the Library of Nuru. The surviving references give the search direction without establishing her complete movements, the date of her ascension or its mechanism.

profile.personality: An ancestral model of scholarship for Scribonia; her spellbook manifestation also expresses joy and companionship.
profile.achievements: Legendary Zuk’Teuc archmage and demigod identified by Vesperax as Keeper of the Arcane Secrets. Legend Lore reveals her arrival carrying books and maps.
profile.relationships: Scribonia models Manifest Mind after her. Vesperax describes her duty to the First God; Ser Kurayami welcomes her in the recovered arrival vision.
